data: Which model has the highest BLUE score at 12 sentences by length?

The question asks for the model with the highest BLEU score at 12 sentences by length. From the caption, we know there are five models represented in the figure: Deep-Att single model, Deep-Att ensemble model, Deep-ED single model, Enc-Dec 4 layers, and SMT. The figure shows these models as different colored lines. At 12 sentences by length, the green line (Deep-Att ensemble model) appears to be the highest among all the lines. Therefore, the Deep-Att ensemble model has the highest BLEU score at 12 sentences by length.
